title: You have to book this one
text: By far one of the best tours ever. Very knowledgeable and extremely charismatic. Would completely recommend this tour to anyone.
author: Trevor_R

title: Excellent wine and tapas tour
text: Raul was a fabulous guide. He shared his knowledge and the history of Sevilla with exuberance, love and humor. We highly recommend a tour with him.
author: Christine_A

title: Anniversary weekend in Sevilla
text:
We didn't go with any tours but literally walked the old city especially around the Jewish Quarter finding amazing Tapas and Wines.
Pre the visit we did our usual research on which restaurants to go to. When we arrived you can find so many great Tapas bars all selling lovely red Tempranillo wines or authentic Sevilla Orange wine we just stopped and ate at the ones that had the best buzz and vibes. I couldn't tell you the names late evening is the best for the area to come alive. Such a friendly city with amazing value for money meals. For two of us with a bottle of red and maybe sharing 8 tapa
author: KeithBuet

title: Fun night in Seville
text: The tapas tour with our guide Maria was really fun.  We learned about the food and wine typical to the region.  Maria was full of information and you could tell was well know and liked in our area by the restaurant owners.  We had four stops and the last stop was for a fantastic glass of sparkling rose and dessert at a rooftop bar.  A fun evening in Seville for sure.
author: janette_s

title: Maria was a fantastic...
text: Maria was a fantastic guide. A lot of great information about the Jewish Quarter and the tapa stops were outstanding. Maria was personable and very friendly.
author: Sarah_C

title: Top Class Tapas
text: A tapas tour is only as good as the host and Raoul was superb. He managed to negotiate his way past/through a number of processions to guide us to fantastic food with charm and patience. Very knowledgeable about Sevilla and a genuine pleasure to enjoy the evening with…
author: Stuart_B

title: Highlight of Seville
text: Maria was an incredible guide.  She took us to off the beaten path places, ordered us delicious food and wine and taught us a great deal about the city. She was friendly, fun and accommodating.
author: Summer_R

title: Agradável experiência
text: Maria is such a lovely person, and the tour overall and places we visited were quite interesting, trying the local cuisine. I was the solo traveler of the group, nonetheless, met and shared a great time with the group on it too.
author: ngelo_F

title: Wine and Tapas
text:
Excellent guide. Punctual and organized.
Wonderful food and wine.
Overall, a pleasant experience.
Well worth the price.
author: Janet_B

title: Very fun, educational tour!
text: We had a fantastic time! Rafa was an excellent guide, making our experience (Jewish quarter tour followed by tapas and wine tour) both fun and educational. He went above and beyond, even coming up with more activities when one of the tapas bars wasn’t open for a few minutes. The tour included a very, very generous amount of wine and three tapas each - definitely recommend coming hungry and thirsty! We went to five total places and had wine at each of them, tapas at three of them, and dessert at one.
author: marinelochka
